pages.title: Orbit Pals
pages.creator: SPNK Studio
pages.description: Orbit Pals is a sorting puzzle with aliens standing on small planets. Move the group at a planet's edge onto an empty planet or matching species, with room for four pals per planet. Bring each species together while managing the limited space.

pages.title: Goblin Mine
pages.creator: MaINK
pages.description: Goblin Mine lets you explore underground zones, mine ore, and sell the contents of your backpack. Spend coins on a stronger pickaxe, more carrying space, or better movement and mining power. Unlock deeper zones and develop pets as your mining operation grows.

pages.title: Bento Match
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Bento Match asks you to slide blocks into straight lines to clear them. Move several pieces together when space allows, but a move that clears nothing costs a life. Earn coins from your score and collect new blocks with different scoring values.

pages.title: Bowmasters
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Bowmasters is a physics-based archery game about hitting enemies with ranged weapons. Drag to set the shot's angle and power, then release toward your opponent. Adjust for distance and trajectory when the previous attempt does not land on target.

pages.title: Italian Animals: Create Your Own Brainrot!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Italian Animals: Create Your Own Brainrot! lets you assemble an absurd creature from separate body parts. Choose a body, head, and legs, confirming each selection. Reveal the resulting character's passport and listen to its generated name before saving your creation.

pages.title: Sudoku
pages.creator: QuadbTech
pages.description: Sudoku challenges you to fill a nine-by-nine grid with the numbers one through nine. Keep each value unique within its row, column, and three-by-three box. Choose a difficulty and use the empty cells' restrictions to work out the missing numbers.

pages.title: Mini Golf Battle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Mini Golf Battle combines miniature golf with obstacle-course puzzles. Drag to aim, pull back for power, and release to send the ball toward the hole. Use walls, ramps, or special shot power-ups while trying to finish with fewer strokes.

pages.title: Kitten Never Dies
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Kitten Never Dies follows a lost kitten through platform challenges in different dimensions. Use a single chosen button to control its jumps and find the way onward. A second player can choose another button for shared play on the same computer.

pages.title: Erase the extra element
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Erase The Extra Element asks you to solve picture puzzles by removing part of a scene. Rub away an area with mouse or touch input to reveal a clue or change the situation. Work out which detail needs to disappear.

pages.title: Troll The Teacher
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Troll The Teacher casts you as a student arranging pranks during a lesson. Choose items such as paper airplanes, eggs, or darts and watch the teacher's reaction. Upgrade your prank equipment to try different ways of disrupting the classroom.

pages.title: Gun Racing
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Gun Racing combines car races with armed attacks on rival vehicles. Drive toward the leading position while using weapons to damage the opposition. Earn money and tickets from events, then buy or improve cars and equipment for further tournaments.

pages.title: Cool Man
pages.creator: SIDM GAMES LLC
pages.description: Cool Man is a platform adventure about running, jumping, and fighting through hazardous levels. Avoid obstacles and enemies while collecting the key along the route. Use keyboard movement or the on-screen controls to continue through ten stages.

pages.title: Summer Connect
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Summer Connect asks you to remove pairs of identical summer-themed tiles. Their connecting line must be clear and use no more than two corners. Some layouts shift after matches, changing the available routes as you race the timer.

pages.title: Panda Adventure
pages.creator: babygames.top
pages.description: Panda Adventure follows a small panda on the way home from school. Run along the route and jump to get past the challenges blocking the way. Keep the panda moving safely through each section toward home.

pages.title: Boss Market
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Boss Market puts you in charge of stocking and expanding a market. Collect products, place them on the appropriate stands, and take payment from customers. Use the earnings to open additional markets and grow the business.

pages.title: Stockings Dilemma
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Stockings Dilemma is a sorting puzzle built around colored and patterned stockings. Rearrange the stockings on a girl's legs to organize matching types. Work through increasingly difficult arrangements while keeping enough room to move the remaining pieces.

pages.title: Daily Horoscope HD
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Daily Horoscope HD is a zodiac-reading activity rather than a competitive game. Choose a sign to open its daily horoscope and browse the presented reading. Additional sign readings are available through the app's advertisement option.

pages.title: Merge Grabber. Race to 2048
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Merge Grabber: Race to 2048 sends a growing squad along an obstacle course. Break columns to recruit characters, pass useful upgrade gates, and build stronger members. Reach the finish with enough power to fight the zombies waiting there.

pages.title: Cube Adventure
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Cube Adventure challenges you to cross dangerous tracks, avoid enemies, and collect keys. Unlock doors to finish levels and keep progressing through the route. Earn gold for new skins and upgrades that strengthen the character.

pages.title: Nubic Boom Crusher
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Nubic Boom Crusher gives you weapons for demolishing structures made of cubes. Aim at the block-built shapes and fire to break them apart. Buy weapons with different characteristics to destroy larger sections of the construction at once.

pages.title: Girl Surfer 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Girl Surfer 3D turns surfing into an obstacle-course run. Slide to steer, collect coins, and rescue girls waiting in the water so they join the group. Avoid barriers along the route and unlock different swimsuit looks.

pages.title: Survivor.io Revenge
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Survivor.io Revenge puts a human survivor against zombies threatening a city. Move through the battlefield while fighting the approaching crowds with your weapons. Keep clear of the surrounding enemies and help the other survivors resist the attack.

pages.title: 2 4 8 link identical numbers
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: 2 4 8 Link Identical Numbers is a number-merging puzzle. Connect equal values horizontally or vertically to form a chain, which combines into a larger-numbered dot. Look for connections that keep useful matches available as you build a higher score.

pages.title: Dinosaur Fusion Simulator
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Dinosaur Fusion Simulator lets you develop an army of dinosaurs and shooters. Send the team against an opposing force and earn rewards for victories. Use those rewards to merge units into stronger forms for the battles ahead.

pages.title: Pecel Skipper
pages.creator: jetlabgames
pages.description: Pecel Skipper puts you in charge of a stall serving an Indonesian dish. Select the menu item a buyer requests, then serve it to that customer. Earn income from successful orders and use it to improve the food stall.

pages.title: Football Superstars 2022
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Football Superstars 2022 lets you choose among seven international teams for football matches. Set up a friendly against a selected opponent or enter the world tournament. Control the team and score goals while trying to win the competition.

pages.title: Rope Bowing Puzzle
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Rope Bowing Puzzle is a physics puzzle about cutting ropes to knock down bottles. Release the suspended ball or other objects in a useful order. Work around barriers and use the resulting movement to reach the remaining targets.

pages.title: KillMaster Secret Agent
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description: KillMaster Secret Agent sends an armed agent through snowy streets occupied by masked enemies. Aim at the opponents and eliminate them as you advance through the levels. Boss encounters introduce harder targets that need careful shooting to defeat.

pages.title: Jungle Run OZ
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Jungle Run OZ puts a monster on a fast run through jungle terrain. Watch for the obstacles ahead and react before they block your path. Keep the creature moving to survive longer through the chase for its next meal.

pages.title: Dibbles For the Greater Good
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Dibbles For The Greater Good asks you to guide a king through a dangerous landscape. Give orders to the Dibbles, whose actions can sacrifice them to create a safe route. Reach the exit with the king while saving as many followers as possible.

pages.title: JUMP
pages.creator: nau.studio
pages.description: JUMP JUMP is a minimalist jumping game with a ball and obstacles to pass. Time each jump to clear the next hazard without making contact. Work through levels that become more difficult as the obstacle arrangements change.

pages.title: Ultra Pixel Survive Winter Coming
pages.creator: Gold Skull Studios
pages.description: Ultra Pixel Survive Winter Coming combines action combat with resource gathering and base survival. Collect wood, stone, and ore, then build barricades and crafting structures. Plant crops or hunt for food while upgrading weapons and developing your heroes.

pages.title: STICK WARRIOR ACTION GAME
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Stick Warrior Action Game sends attackers toward a stickman from both sides. Tap left or right at the right moment to strike an approaching opponent. Keep switching attention between the two directions so the next enemy cannot land a hit.

pages.title: Red and Blue Adventure
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Red And Blue Adventure follows two friends through enemy-filled platform levels. Guide the red and blue characters past the dangers on their route. Coordinate their progress and keep both travelers safe while working through the stages.

pages.title: Dr Panda Farm
pages.creator: Dr. Panda LTD
pages.description: Dr Panda Farm lets you take part in everyday farming activities. Turn wheat into bread, feed chickens, look after cows, and harvest vegetables. Work through the different tasks to see how the farm produces its food.

pages.title: Shaun The Sheep Chick n Spoon
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shaun The Sheep Chick N Spoon challenges you to run while keeping an egg balanced in a spoon. Throw it into the air to collect stars, then catch it again. Dropping the egg or chick costs one of your three lives.

pages.title: Amazing Dominoes
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Amazing Dominoes brings together Muggins, Draw, Block, Sewastpol, and Bergen. Choose a domino mode and a two-, three-, or four-player setup, then play its tile-based rounds. Customize the table's appearance with different themes and domino styles.

pages.title: Square Mineblock
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Square Mineblock sends Steve along a platform route with obstacles and coins. Click to create blocks beneath the character, raising him high enough to pass a barrier. Build the required height while working toward the finish line.

pages.title: Vex 5
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Vex 5 puts a stickman through platform courses filled with traps. Run, jump, and time your movement through the obstacles to finish each level. Explore the stages and work toward achievements as the hazards become more demanding.

pages.title: Animals Jigsaw Puzzle Eagle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Animals Jigsaw Puzzle Eagle offers eight eagle pictures to assemble. Choose a two-by-three, three-by-four, or four-by-six grid and drag the pieces into place. Match the bird's details and the surrounding scene to complete the image.

pages.title: True Or False
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: True Or False tests quick arithmetic decisions against a countdown. Read the displayed calculation and decide whether it is correct before time expires. Correct answers build points, while the increasing pace gives you less time to think.

pages.title: SuperHeroMerge
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: SuperHeroMerge combines merging with a hero's journey through enemies and treasure. Drag compatible heroes or treasure together to increase their level. Build enough strength through useful combinations to defeat the opponents blocking your progress.

pages.title: Cat Wizard Defense
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cat Wizard Defense makes you place cat towers against incoming slime creatures. Destroy slimes to collect energy, then spend it on better defenses. Arrange the towers to stop the attackers before they reach your base across eighteen levels.

pages.title: Trucks in Mud Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Trucks In Mud Jigsaw turns twelve pictures of muddy trucks into jigsaw puzzles. Choose an image and drag its pieces into the correct positions. Match edges and vehicle details until the complete off-road scene is restored.

pages.title: Ninja Run
pages.creator: Pro_Gaming
pages.description: Ninja Run challenges you to keep a ninja moving without falling or hitting obstacles. Use a click, tap, or the space bar to react to the route ahead. Time the movement carefully to get through the next dangerous section.

pages.title: Go to a picnic
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Go To A Picnic lets you prepare a girl's outfit for a weekend outdoors. Browse the available clothing and combine pieces into a picnic look. Try different styles before settling on the appearance for her day out.

pages.title: Finger Spinner
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Finger Spinner challenges you to spin a fidget toy and turn successful spins into coins. Develop a reliable swiping technique, then spend the earnings on upgrades. Unlock more spinner designs while trying to improve your spinning performance.

pages.title: Aris Solitaire
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Aris Solitaire is an arithmetic card puzzle about reaching a target value. Select cards and combine them using addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Work out an expression that produces the number shown on the target card.

pages.title: Happy Bees Jigsaw
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Happy Bees Jigsaw offers six bee pictures to rebuild from scattered pieces. Choose among three puzzle modes, then drag the sections into their correct places. Use the colors and edges to assemble each complete insect-themed image.

pages.title: Granny horror Game 2020
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Granny Horror Game 2020 follows an escape attempt through a frightening location. Move carefully and stay quiet while trying to get out of the danger. Work through the game's levels without drawing the attention of the threatening character nearby.

pages.title: Camping Trip Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Camping Trip Jigsaw offers twelve outdoor holiday pictures as jigsaw puzzles. Pick an easy, medium, or hard setting and arrange the pieces into the complete scene. Use the camping equipment and landscape details to identify where each section belongs.

pages.title: Chained Tractor Bus Towing Duty 2020
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Chained Tractor Bus Towing Duty 2020 puts a tractor to work pulling heavy vehicles with a chain. Drive through the towing missions while controlling the load behind you. Careful acceleration and steering help keep the connected vehicles moving along the route.

pages.title: Knight in Love
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Knight In Love follows a knight trying to rescue a princess captured by a dragon. Attack the castle and collect gold from your progress. Spend it on better weapons and equipment to strengthen the next assault.

pages.title: Xtreme Good And Bad Boys 2
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Xtreme Good And Bad Boys 2 is a multiplayer shooter with fifteen maps. Move between cover and aim at rival players, using the weapons allowed by the current arena. Some maps focus the fight on knives or sniper rifles.

pages.title: Little Dino Adventure Returns
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Little Dino Adventure Returns sends a dinosaur across the Valley of Fear in a platform adventure. Jump past obstacles and keep moving through six levels while collecting golden eggs. Use the keyboard or touch buttons to guide the dinosaur safely along the route.

pages.title: Cannon Ball Defender
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Cannon Ball Defender challenges you to shoot blocks before they reach your position. Fire the cannons at useful moments and clear the approaching threats. Unlock and upgrade equipment to add more powerful projectiles and improve your highest score.

pages.title: Cute Road
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Cute Road puts a car on a course with obstacles and other traffic. Use its ability to jump to get past dangers that cannot be driven through safely. Watch the next section of road and time each leap.

pages.title: Scary Halloween Party
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Scary Halloween Party hides ten stars in each seasonal picture. Search the scene and select every concealed star before the countdown ends. Incorrect clicks reduce the time available, so careful observation helps you get through all six levels.

pages.title: FZ Jet Halloween
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: FZ Jet Halloween sends a flying witch between spooky trees and hanging spiders. Tap to control her height and keep the flight path clear of obstacles. Continue passing the hazards to extend the Halloween-themed run.

pages.title: Muay Thai Training
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Muay Thai Training turns a banana tree into a martial-arts practice target. Throw punches, kicks, and knee strikes to build your score. Keep the training going and work toward unlocking additional characters such as Shaolin and James.

pages.title: Mountain Mystery Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Mountain Mystery Jigsaw provides twelve landscape pictures to assemble. Select a twenty-five, forty-nine, or one-hundred-piece version, then drag the sections into place. Match the mountain scenery and edges until the full image is restored.

pages.title: Space Bubbles
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Space Bubbles is a bubble shooter with seventy levels. Aim a shot at matching colors to create groups of at least three and burst them. Swap the loaded bubble when another color gives you a better opening.

pages.title: Garden Design Games
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Garden Design Games combines garden cleaning, planting, decoration, and a flower-shop activity. Clear rubbish, work the soil, and help plants grow before arranging the surroundings. The different tasks let you develop both the garden and its floral displays.

pages.title: Color Fill
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Color Fill is a movement puzzle about covering every empty block with color. Plan your route through the board before moving. A useful sequence reaches the remaining spaces without leaving an area that your later moves cannot cover.

pages.title: Fishing Party
pages.creator: Neuronality
pages.description: Fishing Party makes you steer a boat close to fish to collect them. Gather the required catch to open the way to the next area, while keeping away from sharks and other dangers. Hold and guide the ship through the available water.

pages.title: EG Candy Lines
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Candy Lines is a matching puzzle with movable jelly pieces. Drag and drop a jelly to form a matching combination and add to your score. Keep looking for useful arrangements as the board changes after each move.

pages.title: Shape Tunnel
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Shape Tunnel is an endless obstacle challenge with a changing shape and circular barriers. Move left or right to align the player with the openings ahead. Keep passing the obstacles to build a higher score.

pages.title: Romantic Spring Wedding
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Romantic Spring Wedding lets you prepare a bride's appearance for her ceremony. Choose clothing and accessories with a spring theme, then combine them into a finished wedding look. Try different selections before settling on the outfit.

pages.title: Crazy Tennis
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Crazy Tennis brings a cartoon style to a tennis match. Move into position and return the ball across the net, aiming to get it past the opponent. Keep the rally alive while looking for an opening to win the point.

pages.title: Princess Toy Store
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Toy Store follows Rachel preparing a new superhero-princess toy shop. Help complete the remaining toys and place them in the store. Work through the preparations so the shelves are ready for the grand opening.

pages.title: Double Guns
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Double Guns challenges you to keep targets in the air with shots from two weapons. Fire in a useful rhythm so the objects do not fall. Missing a target ends the attempt, making careful timing essential to a higher score.

pages.title: 3D Bottle Shooter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: 3D Bottle Shooter puts glass bottles in your sights for a series of shooting levels. Aim and fire to break the targets. Improve the accuracy of your attempts while working toward three stars on each stage.

pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: 100% is a sliding number puzzle about combining cubes to reach the required value. Push the numbered pieces through the grid and account for positive or negative values. Plan the route so the combinations finish at one hundred percent.

pages.title: Princy Throat Surgery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princy Throat Surgery is a fictional medical-care game about helping Princy with a sore throat. Select the available tools and follow the treatment activity on screen. Work through the character's appointment to finish the game's care routine.

pages.title: Mahjong Mania!
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Mahjong Mania! asks you to clear stacked boards by matching identical tiles. Select pairs that are free on at least one side and use their removal to uncover more choices. Quick matching can earn bonus points as you pursue the available cups.

pages.title: Candy Girl Makeup Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Candy Girl Makeup Fun lets you help a girl try a new makeup style. Choose from the available cosmetic options and combine them into a coordinated look. Experiment with the colors before finishing her makeover.

pages.title: Princess Style Vlog: Tips for Brunettes
pages.creator: Natalia Yarovenko
pages.description: Princess Style Vlog: Tips For Brunettes follows Pocahontas and Jasmine presenting makeup and fashion ideas. Help style the brunette princesses while Snow White and Mulan join the activity. Combine the available appearance and clothing choices for the vlog's looks.

pages.title: Marble Blast
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Marble Blast is a limited-move puzzle about triggering marble explosions. Tap a marble to set off a blast and plan how it affects the others. Clear the screen before your available moves are used up.

pages.title: Christmas Parkour Santa
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Christmas Parkour Santa sends Santa through an obstacle course while delivering presents to sleeping children. Jump to avoid hazards and gather coins along the route. Keep Santa moving safely so the holiday delivery can continue.

pages.title: Halloween Pregnant Check Up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Halloween Pregnant Check Up follows a fictional appointment for a pregnant monster princess. Check the heartbeat and use an ultrasound tool to see the baby. Complete the themed examination and music activities as part of the character's visit.

pages.title: Scaled
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Scaled challenges you to shrink a playing area by placing cuts around moving balls. Choose horizontal or vertical divisions and keep the cutting lines clear of the balls. Remove enough space to meet the level's target before losing your lives.

pages.title: Royal Wedding Cake
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Royal Wedding Cake lets you decorate cakes for a royal wedding order. Choose the available design elements and combine them into a finished dessert. Complete each cake's appearance so the princess can prepare her delivery.

pages.title: Quizland Conquest
pages.creator: NetGfx.com
pages.description: Quizland Conquest combines territorial strategy with timed trivia battles. Choose an attack and answer the question to determine the outcome of the encounter. Correct responses help your forces advance while wrong answers give the opposing side an advantage.

pages.title: Princess Fitness Diet
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Fitness Diet follows a princess preparing a salad after a workout. Join the kitchen activity and help assemble the meal from the available ingredients. Work through the preparation steps until the salad is ready.

pages.title: Princess Ellie Dream Wedding
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Ellie Dream Wedding lets you prepare Ellie for her ceremony. Choose a wedding dress, style her hair, and complete the outfit with shoes and accessories. Combine the details into a bridal look suited to the occasion.

pages.title: Bananamania
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Bananamania challenges you to throw bananas toward waiting gorillas from a rotating launcher. Click when the thrower points in the right direction to land the next hit. Watch the changing angles and stage conditions before releasing another banana.
